domain.description:
Domain name. Used to construct url if not provided and also to check for SSL certificates while configuring ELB
listeners.

url.description: URL registered with DNS pointing to ELB

app.description: App running on EMR. For backward compatibility defaults to ex-machina

scheme.description: scheme to use for url. If http, ssl listeners

instancePort.description: Port on which c3 application listens on. For backward compatibility defaults to exmachina's port

elbPort.description: Port on which the elb receives requests to be forwarded to instance port. For backward compatibility defaults to exmachina's port

doNotUpsertListeners.description: if true, listeners are not upserted

listeners.description:
list application for which elb listeners will be upserted. If not specified, then all the EMR application ports will be
added to listener. If doNotUpsertListeners is true, this list is ignored

doNotUpsertHealthCheck.description: If set to true, will not upsert health check
